div.t-att-style: (table_style or '') + '; position: relative; overflow: hidden; box-sizing: border-box; background-color: #fff; padding: 2px 1px 16px 1px; height: 100%; min-height: 100%; border-radius: 0;'

div.style: text-align: center; font-size: 7px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; margin: 0 0 1px 0;

t.t-value: '18px' if name_len <= 12 else '16px' if name_len <= 22 else '13px' if name_len <= 40 else '10px'
'1.0' if name_len <= 12 else '1.05' if name_len <= 22 else '1.08' if name_len <= 40 else '1.0'

div.t-att-style: 'height: 42px; max-height: 42px; overflow: hidden; text-align: center; font-size: ' + name_font_size + '; font-weight: 700; line-height: ' + name_line_height + '; margin: 0; padding: 0 1px; word-break: break-word;'

div.style: position: absolute; left: 1px; bottom: 1px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap;
position: absolute; right: 1px; bottom: 1px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap;

span.style: display: inline-block; width: 34px; border-bottom: 2px solid #000; margin-right: 3px; vertical-align: middle; position: relative; top: 2px;
